nws_afd.quote: FEW-SCT low clouds based 3-5 kft through the coastal basin this afternoon will likely become BKN in coverage tonight in San Diego County with SCT -SHRA just offshore. By late Sunday morning, any lingering low clouds should scatter out with mostly SKC and VFR for Sunday afternoon.

alerts.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 14 at 5:14AM PST until November 15 at 10:00AM PST by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 5
to 7 feet with sets 8 to 10 feet along west-facing beaches.
For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding
expected, particularly along west-facing beaches where surf
will be highest.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the High Surf Advisory, until 10 AM PST Sunday. For
the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 7 AM to 4 PM PST Saturday.
